OD kind: card square red, same as its month bar (10-desk-day-2026-07-31.png); the scenario list does not say which colour OD should be.

A several-day input prints 'till <date>' twice on its card: in the corner and again as its remark (12-phone-list.png). A cross-year input's remark says 'till 1 Jan' with no year while the corner says 'till 1 Jan 2027' (17-phone-list-cross-year.png).

Just-saved card kept in view while filters hide it stands ABOVE earlier dates (Tue 4 Aug heading above Tue 21 Jul) in 22-phone-after-add.png - likely by design (brought into view), reported only so the host knows.

Desktop 1440x900, a shared input's window after pressing Delete: the 'Keep' button of 'Delete this input for all N people?' lies below the window's bottom edge (measured Keep 883-919 px, window bottom 876, screen 900), so it needs a scroll inside the window to reach; Delete itself is visible (25-desktop 1440-delete-question.png, x-explore-keep-visible.png).

Desktop, a saved shared input's window shows a PERSONNEL strip 'All, Cotter, Ratchet, Widget' as small grey chips that are not the entry's own people (Drifter/Echo/Ranger/Saber, or Anvil/Basher/Cinch) - x-explore-keep-visible.png, 25-desktop 1440-delete-question.png. May be an older strip, not this feature.

New-input window calendar (not the saved-input two-tap one): the opening day is pre-selected; tapping that same day and then another day gives a one-day input on the second day, while tapping only the other day gives a range (my script learned this on 12; the all-day 20-22 Jul filing first saved as one day). Reported as behaviour seen.
The Upchit window opens with its Date on 13 Jul although the Medical page was 'as of 22 Jul' (x-explore-upchit1.png).
The list's date picker pop-over stays open after the end date is tapped, and Escape does not close it (21-phone-window-*.png before my re-run).
notRun: None of my scenarios was left unrun. Scenario 15 was run with Playwright's own clock (context.clock.install at 1 Jun 2026, then setSystemTime to 1 Jul 2026; fastForward by 30 days was refused by the API, 'cannot fast-forward to the past'), no app state written.

Scenario 12 on a desktop has no list card to judge (the desktop list is the table) - I judged the opened days and the table on the desktop and added an extra phone world for the list card (row '12 (extra...)').
Scenario 10: all 22 kinds on the desktop opened day; on the phone list 8 kinds (LL, OML, ATT C, CCL, Training, Meeting, Duty, Event).
